ns2:section.sectionText: Please note: This section will have synchronous (live) sessions, on Tuesdays and Thursdays during the scheduled class day/time listed in Course Explorer. In addition, students will be expected to complete additional coursework on their own. Students are highly recommended to have a high speed internet connection (preferably not wireless) and a microphone or headset with microphone for course interaction during the live sessions. If seats remain, they may open to Sophomore majors in ADV, CS+ADV, and Ag Comm on May 10.
